suite_constraints.gpu: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3050 Laptop GPU, 6 GiB

zenodo_ctr_collection.important_correction: Earlier supplemental text said CC BY 4.0 metadata. Current Zenodo record has no license in its Rights section; that prior statement is withdrawn.

candidates.name: Criteo Display Advertising Challenge CTR
candidates.task: binary click prediction on displayed-ad rows; directly compatible with a pointwise MLP if categorical IDs are one-hot encoded and label leakage is excluded
candidates.features: 13 numeric and 26 categorical fields plus click label
candidates.access: Zenodo lists a public Download link; actual full anonymous GET not tested
candidates.rights: Zenodo Rights/License blank; related Kaggle challenge terms apply to challenge release; no permissive data license established
candidates.difficulty: Not empirically piloted. A direct click label and real impression rows are documented; held-out MLP non-saturation remains unverified.
candidates.disposition: cross out for full-batch capacity and unresolved reuse rights; no pilot

candidates.name: Avazu CTR
candidates.task: binary click prediction on mobile-ad rows; directly compatible with a pointwise MLP if categorical identifiers are one-hot encoded
candidates.features: 23 fields, mostly categorical, plus click label
candidates.access: Zenodo lists a public Download link; actual full anonymous GET not tested
candidates.rights: Zenodo Rights/License blank; upstream Kaggle challenge terms apply to original challenge data; no permissive data license established
candidates.difficulty: Not empirically piloted. Source reports labeled click responses; no saturation claim is made.
candidates.disposition: cross out for full-batch capacity and unresolved reuse rights; no pilot

candidates.name: iPinYou RTB CTR
candidates.task: binary click prediction from impression/context rows; use only pre-outcome features and retain campaign/time groups
candidates.features: bid request, user, publisher, ad-slot and campaign context; clicks are observed
candidates.official_split: first seven days train, final three days test, by campaign
candidates.access: Zenodo lists a public Download link; actual full anonymous GET not tested
candidates.rights: Zenodo Rights/License blank; original paper says publicly released for research, not a permissive reuse license
candidates.difficulty: Not empirically piloted. Rare click prevalence is reported (about 14.8k clicks of 19.5m impressions); difficulty and useful held-out learning remain unverified.
candidates.disposition: cross out for full-batch capacity and unresolved reuse rights; no pilot

openml_click_prediction_small.interpretation: The word Public describes visibility/access, not a standard open-data license. No upstream license permitting reuse was established for the KDD-derived versions.

openml_click_prediction_small.difficulty: The sampled KDD variants report a roughly 5:1 label ratio; no MLP pilot was run, so non-saturation is unverified. The 0.1% variants are also highly reduced samples and cannot stand in for the full challenge benchmark.
